tools.name: search_availability
tools.description: Open and booked nights for Wanaka Haus (sleeps 8, Wānaka NZ) in a date window, up to 18 months ahead. Ranges are check-in inclusive, check-out exclusive.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Itemised NZD total for a stay at Wanaka Haus. Validates the stay rules (minimum nights, peak-season minimum, guest cap) and checks the dates are open, before you commit to a booking.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Book Wanaka Haus: atomically holds the dates for 30 minutes and returns a Stripe Checkout URL. The booking confirms only when payment completes on that URL — give it to your user to pay (or pay with an agent wallet's one-time card). No account or API key needed.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Status of a Wanaka Haus booking: held, confirmed, cancelled or lapsed.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a Wanaka Haus booking under the published policy (full refund to 14 days before arrival, 50% to 7 days, none inside 7). Requires the guest email the booking was made with.
